Frappe ERPNext 15.10.4 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that checks whether an inventory number exists and creates missing Serial No and Batch master records without verifying create permission. Authenticated users can send a crafted request with a new number to create these records outside their role, affecting inventory data integrity.

CVE Notify
🚨 CVE-2026-67210
diaspora* through 0.10.1, using the diaspora_federation gem through 1.2.0, contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the pod send requests to arbitrary internal hosts by supplying a crafted diaspora handle to the GET /link endpoint, which triggers WebFinger discovery without private-address filtering. Attackers can specify a handle containing an IPv4/IPv6 address and port such as diaspora://probe@host:port to force the HttpClient to connect to loopback, RFC1918, link-local, or cloud metadata addresses, enabling blind probing of the pod's internal network.

CVE Notify
🚨 CVE-2026-74025
A flaw was found in ironic-image. The scripts responsible for constructing kernel parameters for CoreOS root file system (rootfs) and Ignition configuration URLs use a hardcoded `http://` scheme. This bypasses the intended Transport Layer Security (TLS) protection, even when TLS is enabled for the iPXE boot chain. An attacker on the local network segment can exploit this vulnerability by performing Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) spoofing to serve a malicious rootfs or intercept sensitive data, including SSH keys and secrets, from the Ignition configuration. This leads to a compromise of data integrity and confidentiality during the node provisioning process.
